question: What does Clind-san think about his disciple (?) Subaru-kun taking on the mantle of ‘Little Girl User’? Is he overjoyed?
answer: “One has appeared to carry on the work of the ‘Little Girl User’, then…” is something he whispered emotionally and surprised Annerose, but he doesn’t have any particular connection to it, so today, too, he’s just making his way along normally.
